title: Text: DET Matt Boyd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey man, it's ███████. Just checking in to say what up. How is everything going down there?
Hey ███████, going great man. Getting better everyday. How u doing?
Good, got a day off. I've had three since April 25. It's been rough with the trips
Good hearing from you. Haven't forgotten about you lol...keep it up, see you soon.
I bet. Enjoy your time off man. It's needed. Haha. Thank you. See you soon.
